design_contract: Separate standalone classic Shadowsocks and standalone SS2022 workloads; SS2022 inclusion depends on all candidate compatibility, and omission must be explicit if not common-supported.
Report classic SS, SS2022, SS/VLESS/VMess inbound-to-WireGuard outbound as distinct workload families; each should separate TCP from any supported UDP path.
Use one identical classic AEAD cipher/password config on every classic-capable candidate; validate SS2022 separately with its own method/key constraints.
Use common fixed client and WG gateway; relay source/build is the only varied node. Validate byte delivery to the intended WG-routed receiver per direction/case.
audit_requirements_sent_to_chainbench: Preserve TCP upload and download separately, and each supported UDP case with explicit protocol, transport, direction, bytes, and status; retain unsupported/error cases.
Measure established-session application 64-byte request/response RTT with monotonic timing, excluding connection/setup; any setup metric must be separately labeled.
Report standalone protocol results separately from WG chains. Do not infer RTT from throughput or use a bind microbenchmark as relay E2E evidence.
